label: copy-phase fed-back digit 3 (mid/late recall)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, when the input fed back is a repeat of an original token. 89% of activation mass is on input 3; the rest is mostly input 1 (7%) and q (3.5%). It is silent in the original and delimiter phases, and at recall_idx < 2. Strongest at recall_idx 3-4 (t 12-13) and in longer sequences. Only about 20% of copy-phase 3 inputs at recall_idx >= 3 fire, so precision is low. Magnitude is higher when the token being output at that step is 1, q or c (precision 0.71 for that subset, which holds the top activations, e.g. ...3 1 q...), and when the sequence has many digits. Does not fire on other letters or on digits 0 and 2.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: 3, 1, q, c, f, p; least: u, e, m, t) and the token being output (most: q, 1, c, 3, z, y; least: k, -, r, i); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=4, recall_idx=3, L=9 & t=13.
